blurb: Guests can rent kayaks, stand up paddle boards, canoes, and tandem kayaks to paddle on the scenic Ausable River or transport rentals to other locations in the Adirondack region. Rentals are available at their river location or with delivery upon reservation. The rental season runs from late May to mid September, depending on safe paddling conditions.
extraNote: Any rental 3 days or over will receive a 25% off total purchase · Rental location at 2656 U.S. 9 Peru, NY 12972 · Late May through mid September
